characteristics.name: gps
characteristics.inert: the CCCD exists; no notification is ever sent on it

characteristics.name: can
characteristics.inert: the CCCD exists; no notification is ever sent on it

characteristics.name: imu
characteristics.inert: the CCCD exists; no notification is ever sent on it

characteristics.name: control
characteristics.inert: the CCCD exists; writes are rejected with an ATT error and no opcode is parsed

characteristics.name: monitor_values
characteristics.inert: writes are rejected with an ATT error and change nothing

characteristics.name: aiding
characteristics.inert: writes are silently discarded; a client cannot reach this characteristic legitimately without GNSS_AID_BEGIN having answered ok first

members.name: bad_params
members.desc: Parameters malformed or out of range

members.name: rate_exceeded
members.desc: Requested rate is above gps_max_rate_hz or imu_max_rate_hz (SPEC.md 9.6). Never used for CAN

members.name: busy
members.desc: A response is already outstanding; wait for it, then retry (SPEC.md 9)

members.name: needs_encryption
members.desc: Allocated, never sent: encryption is enforced by GATT permission (SPEC.md 10)

members.name: unknown_subscription
members.desc: No installed subscription with that id and mask

members.name: lap_time
members.desc: Elapsed time in the current lap, ms

members.name: delta_best
members.desc: Time ahead of or behind the best lap, ms, signed

members.name: lap_number
members.desc: Laps completed in this session, from 1

members.name: external
members.desc: Running from an external supply. Says nothing about a battery: `percent` reports one if the device has one

members.name: charging
members.desc: External supply present, battery taking charge

members.name: charged
members.desc: External supply present, battery no longer taking charge

members.name: ubx_mga
members.desc: A concatenated sequence of UBX-MGA messages, as served by u-blox AssistNow

members.name: applied
members.desc: Every chunk arrived, the CRC matched, and the data went to the receiver

members.name: incomplete
members.desc: One or more chunks are missing; first_missing names the lowest

members.name: bad_crc
members.desc: Every chunk arrived and the CRC-32 does not match

members.name: rejected
members.desc: The transfer was intact and the receiver refused it

bits.name: t_utc
bits.desc: t_utc carries a GNSS time solution

bits.name: t_utc_resolved
bits.desc: Leap seconds fully resolved

bits.name: position
bits.desc: lat and lon are valid

bits.name: velocity
bits.desc: vel_n, vel_e and vel_d are all valid

gps_validity.reserved_purpose: Validity for fields added in a later minor

bits.name: differential
bits.desc: Differential corrections applied

bits.name: clock_disciplined
bits.desc: t_device was GNSS-disciplined at this sample

bits.name: solution_epoch
bits.desc: t_device is the epoch of the solution; when clear it is when the fix reached the device (SPEC.md 5.6)

bits.name: monitor
bits.desc: Device asks the client for values to display (§13)

bits.name: power
bits.desc: Device reports its own power state (SPEC.md 9.7)

bits.name: gnss_aiding
bits.desc: Client supplies orbit data to the device's receiver (§14)

capabilities.reserved_purpose: Roles and features added in a later minor

bits.name: shedding
bits.desc: Device is discarding accepted frames (SPEC.md 6.3)

bits.name: accel
bits.desc: Accelerometer triple is present

bits.name: gyro
bits.desc: Gyroscope triple is present

bits.name: saturated
bits.desc: A sample in this batch hit the sensor's limit (SPEC.md 7.2)

bits.name: gnss_disciplined
bits.desc: The device clock is disciplined by GNSS

bits.name: survives_reconnect
bits.desc: The device clock does not restart when the link drops

bits.name: present
bits.desc: The client can currently supply this channel

monitor_validity.reserved_purpose: Validity for values added in a later minor

bits.name: source
bits.desc: source is valid

bits.name: percent
bits.desc: percent is valid

power_validity.reserved_purpose: Validity for power fields added in a later minor

bits.name: held_until
bits.desc: held_until carries the end of a window the device already holds

aid_validity.reserved_purpose: Validity for aiding capabilities added in a later minor

bits.name: first_missing
bits.desc: first_missing names a chunk the device did not receive

commit_validity.reserved_purpose: Validity for commit results added in a later minor

info.desc: Device self-description. Read once per connection; never cached across connections.

fields.name: protocol_major
fields.desc: MUST equal 1; cross-check against the discovered service UUID

fields.name: gps_rate_hz
fields.desc: Current rate; 0 if no GPS

fields.name: reserved_20
fields.desc: Was can_max_payload; derived from the capability bits since (SPEC.md 4.1)

fields.name: reserved_22
fields.desc: Was max_notify_bytes; a notification is bounded by the negotiated ATT payload, which the client's stack already knows (SPEC.md 2)

gps_fix.desc: One complete position solution. Never split, never paired, never packed.

fields.name: seq
fields.desc: Notifications sent on this characteristic; +1 each, wraps, restarts at 0 per connection

fields.name: dropped
fields.desc: Fixes accepted then discarded since the previous notification; saturates, never wraps

fields.name: t_device
fields.desc: Monotonic device clock (§8.1)

fields.name: t_utc
fields.desc: Unix epoch

fields.name: lat
fields.desc: Latitude — positive north, negative south

fields.name: lon
fields.desc: Longitude — positive east, negative west

fields.name: alt_msl
fields.desc: Altitude above mean sea level

fields.name: alt_ellipsoid
fields.desc: Altitude above the WGS-84 ellipsoid

fields.name: vel_n
fields.desc: Velocity, north component

fields.name: vel_e
fields.desc: Velocity, east component

fields.name: vel_d
fields.desc: Velocity, down component — positive descending

fields.name: head_mot
fields.desc: Heading of motion, clockwise from true north

fields.name: h_acc
fields.desc: Horizontal position accuracy estimate, 1 sigma

fields.name: v_acc
fields.desc: Vertical position accuracy estimate, 1 sigma

fields.name: s_acc
fields.desc: Speed accuracy estimate, 1 sigma

fields.name: p_dop
fields.desc: Position dilution of precision

fields.name: num_sv
fields.desc: Satellites used in the solution

fields.name: ext_count
fields.desc: Extension records following the base record

can_header.desc: Batch header. Followed by `count` can_record entries.

fields.name: seq
fields.desc: Notifications sent on this characteristic; +1 each, wraps, restarts at 0 per connection

fields.name: dropped
fields.desc: Frames accepted then discarded since the previous notification; excludes frames no subscription matched or a subscription mode did not select; saturates

fields.name: t_base
fields.desc: Bus-arrival time of record 0, on the device clock (§8.1)

fields.name: reserved
fields.desc: Low byte earmarked for a bus index (SPEC.md 6.9); high byte unassigned

can_record.desc: One CAN frame with a device-measured bus-arrival time.

fields.name: dt
fields.desc: Ticks since this batch's own t_base; window is 0..655.35 ms

fields.name: id
fields.desc: bits 0-28 arbitration id; b29 extended; b30 CAN FD; b31 RTR

fields.name: len
fields.desc: Payload length; Classic 0..8, CAN FD a DLC rung (SPEC.md 6.10)

imu_header.desc: Batch header. Followed by `count` evenly spaced imu_sample entries.

fields.name: seq
fields.desc: Notifications sent on this characteristic; +1 each, wraps, restarts at 0 per connection

fields.name: dropped
fields.desc: Samples accepted then discarded since the previous notification; saturates, never wraps

fields.name: t_base
fields.desc: Device-clock timestamp of sample 0 (§8.1)

fields.name: period
fields.desc: Interval between consecutive samples

fields.name: reserved
fields.desc: In-band IMU metadata

imu_sample.desc: Sensor-frame acceleration and rotation. Vehicle alignment is the client's job.

fields.name: ax
fields.desc: milli-g

monitor_declaration.desc: Every channel this device asks the client to supply. Followed by `count` monitor_channel entries.

fields.name: count
fields.desc: Channels requested; the whole declaration, never a page of it

fields.name: reserved
fields.desc: Declaration metadata

monitor_channel.desc: One channel a device asks the client to supply.

fields.name: slot
fields.desc: The device's own name for this value; used in monitor_value

fields.name: max_age
fields.desc: Longest this value may be shown without a refresh; MUST NOT be zero (SPEC.md 13.5)

monitor_header.desc: Batch header for a client-to-device value update. Followed by `count` monitor_value entries.

fields.name: seq
fields.desc: Updates written by the client; +1 each, wraps, restarts at 0 per connection

fields.name: reserved
fields.desc: Update metadata

monitor_value.desc: One value for a slot the device asked for.

control_response.desc: The envelope of every Control response. Detail follows only when status is ok.

fields.name: opcode
fields.desc: Echoed from the request

fields.name: tag
fields.desc: Echoed from the request; opaque to the device

time_sync.desc: The detail of a TIME_SYNC response. Two readings of one clock, so a client can bound its own error.

fields.name: t_device_rx
fields.desc: Device clock when the request arrived

fields.name: t_device_tx
fields.desc: Device clock when this answer was prepared; MUST NOT be earlier than t_device_rx

power_state.desc: The detail of a GET_POWER response. What the device knows about its own supply, and no more.

fields.name: percent
fields.desc: Charge remaining, 0..100; a device MUST NOT emit a larger value (SPEC.md 9.7)

fields.name: reserved
fields.desc: Power metadata

gnss_aid_caps.desc: What aiding this device accepts, and what it already holds.

fields.name: format
fields.desc: The one format this device accepts

fields.name: reserved_2
fields.desc: Was aid_flags; aiding metadata

fields.name: max_bytes
fields.desc: Largest total_bytes this device will accept in one transfer

fields.name: held_until
fields.desc: Unix epoch; the end of the validity window this device already holds (SPEC.md 14.2)

aid_begin_result.desc: The detail of a GNSS_AID_BEGIN response. Opens a transfer and fixes its chunking.

fields.name: token
fields.desc: Names this transfer; echoed in every chunk. MUST differ from the previous transfer's (SPEC.md 14.3)

fields.name: chunk_bytes
fields.desc: Payload bytes in every chunk but the last; byte offset is index x chunk_bytes (SPEC.md 14.3)

fields.name: reserved_3
fields.desc: Transfer metadata

aid_chunk.desc: One chunk of an aiding transfer, written without a response.

fields.name: token
fields.desc: Echoed from the GNSS_AID_BEGIN that opened this transfer

fields.name: index
fields.desc: 0-based; the payload belongs at index x chunk_bytes

aid_commit_result.desc: The detail of a GNSS_AID_COMMIT response. What became of the transfer.

fields.name: first_missing
fields.desc: Lowest chunk index the device did not receive; the client resends from here (SPEC.md 14.4)

opcodes.name: CAN_RESET
opcodes.desc: Clear all subscriptions and stop the CAN stream

opcodes.name: CAN_UNSUBSCRIBE
opcodes.desc: Removes the subscription whose id and mask these are (SPEC.md 9.1)

opcodes.name: GPS_SET_RATE
opcodes.desc: 0 stops the stream; unsupported rates answer bad_params (SPEC.md 9.6)

opcodes.name: GNSS_AID_INFO
opcodes.desc: What aiding this device accepts, and what it already holds (SPEC.md 14.2)

opcodes.name: GNSS_AID_BEGIN
opcodes.desc: Open a transfer; the response fixes the chunk size (SPEC.md 14.3)

opcodes.name: GNSS_AID_COMMIT
opcodes.desc: Close the open transfer and report what became of it (SPEC.md 14.4)

opcodes.name: IMU_SET_RATE
opcodes.desc: 0 stops the stream; unsupported rates answer bad_params (SPEC.md 9.6)

opcodes.name: TIME_SYNC
opcodes.desc: The device clock when the request arrived and when the answer was prepared (SPEC.md 9.5)

opcodes.name: MONITOR_LIST
opcodes.desc: Every channel this device asks the client to supply, in one response (SPEC.md 13.3)

opcodes.name: GET_POWER
opcodes.desc: What the device knows about its own supply, measured when asked (SPEC.md 9.7)
